3088: Looking after mental health at work does not require perfect answers or clinical training.
3089: Above all, it requires a willingness to observe, listen and connect people to the right support. Small gestures – an attentive question, a safe space to talk, the courage not to ignore the distress of the person beside us – make all the difference.
3090: PFA is human, close and practical support for someone who is struggling – in a way that always respects their dignity, their culture and their abilities. It does not replace clinical care, but it is often the first step that makes the difference.
